- WeChat: dominant in China and many Asian markets, also functions as a payment, social media and life service super app
- Telegram: known for supporting very large group chats, cloud-based message storage and customizable channels
- Signal: open-source, privacy-focused app with industry-leading end-to-end encryption
- iMessage: Apple's default built-in messaging app for iOS and macOS devices
- Facebook Messenger: Meta's standalone instant messaging service tied to Facebook social accounts
